source: The commonly used FIRE flavours. Expense factors are conventions, not published figures.
note: SPEC.md Section 13 — five flavours of expenses x 25, each changing the expense assumption or adding a twist. Section 8 requires ONE parameterised calculateFIRE() rather than five calculators, so this file holds the parameters and engines/fire.js holds the single formula. The expenseFactor values are Assumption-class: a user override is a local preview, never a write.

defaults.note: Coast asks what you would need TODAY to reach the standard number by this age with no further contributions.

variants.label: FIRE
variants.blurb: Your expenses, covered forever at your withdrawal rate.

variants.label: Lean FIRE
variants.blurb: The same freedom on a deliberately smaller life — roughly 70% of what you spend now.

variants.label: Chubby FIRE
variants.blurb: Comfortable rather than frugal — about 25% more than you spend now.

variants.label: Fat FIRE
variants.blurb: No belt-tightening at all — around 50% above today's spending.

variants.label: Coast FIRE
variants.blurb: The point where you can stop contributing entirely and still land on the full number by your target age. You still cover your own costs until then.

variants.label: Barista FIRE
variants.blurb: Part-time work covers some of the bill, so the pot only has to cover the rest.
